reviews.title: Support isn’t great
reviews.text: The counselors are overwhelmed, the support staff is not great. I’ve sent two emails with an issue I’m having with their systems. I have yet to receive a response. While the app does work to help you cut down or stop drinking, having to wait 2-3 weeks for a counselor is tough and the support staff needs some work.

reviews.title: Okay as an incentive.
reviews.text: This app is ok if you have already established a reliable support system and just want extra incentive. It’s terrible if you’re using it as a stand alone, but they do kind of tell you that up front. Buttons in the app are glitchy. Reward points don’t always go through (especially on weekends). Support feature is not an AI or live chat and it seems typical to go days without a response and/or to not get a response at all.

reviews.title: Can’t change your program

I have never used an opioid in my life, but thanks to a misclick on sign up, this app now insists I have an opioid problem and provides no way to change that.

reviews.title: Hope Lost Completely
reviews.text:
This app once was called No Butts… and it was Free! And it gave me hope that one day, and against great mental health odds, that despite what numerous doctors were saying, that I was going to be able to quit smoking. HOPE WAS ALIVE!

But now, with the changes made to the app, Hope is Again Lost. 

It’s such a shame because I had promising feelings from the No Butts app, it just wasn’t the right time to face such a challenge due to a hostile work environment, a relationship with a diagnosed sociopath, a world altering injury…. Yeah…. 

I just wish quitting could not be impossible for me. 
I thought this app held the answer… but alas…. Unless you are in their magical network, it isn’t going to happen.
I like to know if y’all have my address for my meds?

reviews.title: The dumbest app ever
reviews.text: So my employer wants to charge $75 per month for being a smoker towards insurance and they’ve contracted this dumb app/company to conduct a cessation/quitting program. This apps process is ridiculously convoluted and requirements are buried so deep you’d need a shovel to find and comply with them. And a requirement is to message a coach 5 different weeks and only vaguely reference how to do that. Then when they do, it just states the “coach tab is how to contact the coach”. Problem is there’s no coach tab. If the people who are creating this app are the future, WE ARE SCREWED!!

reviews.title: Initial Phone Call Connect
reviews.text: Appointment was schedule for 9:00. As instructed I set aside 30 minutes for the call. I received the call from Coach Cassandra Sarver @ 9:21,therefore only having 9 minutes for convenience. I was disappointed my coach was not familiar with my case, asking me questions previously answered. I was hoping for solid information on coping with my evening cravings. But, due to the many initial repetitive questions the allotted time was spent. I will continue with Pelago in hopes for better support.

reviews.text:
When I first started, I thought this was absolutely ridiculous. However, as I went through the motions, I found myself getting into it and becoming more serious about quitting. You need to do the work. If your willing to go down the path to a healthier lifestyle then you may find this useful. The councilors where nice when times got tuff. They are in your corner and encouraging.

It’s nice sometimes to have someone you can talk to when it gets hard. 

I would recommend.
